tags.name: Fleet Operations & Tracking
tags.description: Endpoints for tracking vehicles, trailers, assets, and trip activity — including locations, movements, and operational telemetry. Useful for monitoring utilization and real-time operational status.

tags.name: Safety & Driver Behavior
tags.description: Endpoints that provide safety-related insights such as harsh braking, speeding, and other driver behavior events. Supports risk analysis and safety program automation.

tags.name: Compliance & Regulation
tags.description: Endpoints covering regulated requirements including DVIR inspections, Hours of Service (HOS), violations, and IFTA fuel tax reporting. Helps organizations meet DOT/FMCSA and interstate regulatory obligations.

tags.name: Maintenance & Vehicle Health
tags.description: Endpoints providing data for vehicle condition monitoring and maintenance workflows, such as DVIR defects and diagnostic sensor events. Enables early issue detection and reduced downtime.

tags.name: Drivers & Users
tags.description: Endpoints related to driver and user identities, assignments, and operational context. Supports linking operational and safety data to specific individuals.

tags.name: Reference Data (Supporting Tables)
tags.description: Lookup tables and enumerations that supply standardized codes, metadata, and classifications used across the API.

tags.name: Analytics
tags.description: Endpoints providing analytical insights and aggregated data for vehicles, fleets, drivers, and trailers.
